bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder March 12, 2021

Karen Shortsleeve was recently accepted into the Copley Society of Art in Boston, a high honor, and has sold her first painting through them. The Copley Society of Art is the oldest non-profit arts association in the United States, with a history dating back to 1879. Learn more at https://copleysociety.org/.

Congratulations, Karen!
